description: This is a C# source file (Program.cs) for an ASP.NET Core web API backend that configures and sets up the entire web application, including services, middleware, API endpoints, health checks, Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, CORS, database configuration, and various asset management functionalities. It defines routes for CRUD operations on assets and their related entities such as copy lineage, status logs, additional IDs, properties, control device mappings, reporting attribute mappings, input parameters, and parent-child input mappings. The code initializes the web application, registers dependencies, and configures endpoint handlers with detailed request validation, error handling, and response shaping.
